reach.title: Where can I reach?
reach.subtitle: The forecast below is aimed at {{place}}.
reach.answer: {{band}} reaches {{place}} at {{hour}} UTC — about {{percent}} chance of contact.
reach.mapLoading: Working out where this band reaches
reach.mapUnavailable: The coverage map could not be loaded.
reach.reachLine: {{band}} reaches about {{percent}} of the world at this hour.

window.label: Usable window
window.explain: Above {{ceiling}} the signal passes through the ionosphere into space. Below {{floor}} it is absorbed on the way up. Those two are the MUF and the LUF.
window.explainNoFloor: Above {{ceiling}} the signal passes through the ionosphere into space — that is the MUF. No frequency was reliable enough this hour to set a floor.

grid.footnoteHours: Hours are UTC. Local time at {{place}} is on the clock above.
grid.footnoteSaved: This is saved data, so it cannot show anything that changed since it was fetched.

sections.allBandsHint: How far each band gets you, hour by hour.
sections.noneReach: No band reaches {{place}} at any hour today.

spaceWeather.kpSaved: Last reading. A storm since then would be invisible
spaceWeather.unavailable: Live readings are unavailable, so this forecast uses typical conditions for the month.
spaceWeather.measured: Sounder at {{station}}, {{distance}} away, measured foF2 {{value}} at {{time}} UTC.

location.title: Choose a path
location.permissionDenied: Location permission was declined. Search for a place instead.
location.unavailable: Your location could not be read. Search for a place instead.
location.noProvider: Location is switched off on this device. Turn it on, or search for a place instead.

status.errorBody: The prediction service at {{address}} did not answer.
status.errorLoopback: That address is this device itself, so there is nothing there to answer. Set the address of the machine running the server.

disclaimer.climatology: Monthly climatology, not a live forecast. Assumes smoothed sunspot number {{ssn}} and quiet geomagnetic conditions.
disclaimer.forecast: Monthly climatology using a predicted sunspot number of {{ssn}}. Forecasts further ahead are less certain.
disclaimer.nowcast: Driven by current readings, with an effective sunspot number of {{ssn}}. This estimates the ionosphere, not this path.
disclaimer.station: Assumes 100 W into a dipole 10 m up. A better antenna beats these numbers; a compromise antenna will not reach them.

a11y.swapEnds: Swap the two ends of the path
a11y.windowRail: Usable window: floor {{floor}}, ceiling {{ceiling}}. Tap for an explanation.
a11y.nvis: Reaches by near-vertical incidence, so there is no skip zone.
a11y.sounding: Measured foF2 {{value}} from the sounder at {{station}}, {{distance}} away, at {{time}} UTC. This is a real measurement, not part of the forecast.
a11y.coverage: Coverage map. {{band}} reaches about {{percent}} percent of the world at this hour.
a11y.mapLegend: Map key. The purple shades are predicted reach, weakest to strongest. The grey wash is night.

crash.title: Something went wrong
crash.body: This screen could not be drawn. That is a fault in the app, not a problem with the forecast.

station.title: Your radio
station.modeHint: Listed hardest first. A digital mode can work a path that voice cannot.
station.modeNeeds: {{mode}} needs {{db}} dB above the noise on this path.
station.heightNote: Height decides most of the answer. On 20 metres, a dipole a wavelength up beats one a quarter wave up by about 9 dB on a long path.
station.isotropicNote: An equal signal in every direction. Not a real antenna, but it assumes nothing about yours.

tip.mode: {{mode}}: needs {{db}} dB above the noise. Tap to change.
tip.isotropic: No antenna assumed. Tap to describe yours.
tip.wire: Favours {{first}}° and {{second}}° equally, at right angles to the wire. Tap to change.

a11y.mode: Mode: {{mode}}, needing {{db}} decibels above the noise
a11y.gain: Antenna gain over a dipole, in decibels
a11y.name: Name of this station
a11y.addHint: Copies this station so you can change one thing
a11y.presetHint: Opens the list of your saved stations
a11y.wire: Direction the wire runs, in degrees

station.powerRange: Anything from {{min}} W to {{max}} W. Below {{min}} W the model stops tracking power.
station.wireRuns: Which way does the wire run?
station.favoursTwo: Favours {{first}}° and {{second}}° equally, at right angles to the wire. It hears least off the ends.
station.verticalNote: A vertical is the same in every direction, so there is nothing to point.

aim.best: {{place}} is at {{degrees}}°. Your nearest strong direction is {{lobe}}°, so it is {{offset}}° away — close to it.
aim.offToOneSide: {{place}} is at {{degrees}}°. Your nearest strong direction is {{lobe}}°, so it is {{offset}}° off to one side.
aim.nearNull: {{place}} is at {{degrees}}°. Your nearest strong direction is {{lobe}}°, so it is {{offset}}° away — near where this antenna is weakest.

server.title: Server address
server.explain: HFcast reads its forecasts from a prediction server. Enter the address of the machine running it — a host and port is enough.
server.invalid: That is not an address this can use.
